## Getting started

### Packages

We'll use the **tidyverse** package for this analysis.

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Data

The data are modeled on the building-level energy records a campus facilities office might keep. The building names are real UCSB buildings, but **every other value is simulated** for teaching purposes (the energy use, year built, size, building type, and zone groupings are not facts about these buildings). The data are in the `data` folder.

-   `building-energy.csv`: one row per building, with its type, year built, size, and annual energy use (kilowatt-hours per square foot).
-   `campus-zones.csv`: one row per building, with the campus zone (Science, Arts & Humanities, Student Life, or Admin & Services) it belongs to.

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
building_energy <- read_csv("data/building-energy.csv")
campus_zones <- read_csv("data/campus-zones.csv")
```

And let's take a look at the data.

```{r glimpse}
glimpse(building_energy)
glimpse(campus_zones)
```
